notes: BUB1B compound heterozygote — NM_001211.6:c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter (nonsense; ClinVar 533901 Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic 2-star; gnomAD exomes NFE AF 9.98e-5) and c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys (missense; gnomAD exomes NFE AF 8.99e-7; not in ClinVar — ClinVar holds c.3006T>A, a different nucleotide with the same protein change, VUS, which does not transfer). Consistent with MVA1 (OMIM 257300, autosomal recessive). Only gene in the analysis carrying two rare damaging alleles. Phase not demonstrated: no parental sample and the variants are ~11 kb apart.
